summary: Independent complete-diff review against e72629995ce2f12d190f47cc1d96a35dc22445a6 confirmed two high-severity defects: interruption during separate snapshot cleanup mixes rollback generations, and the uninstall harness can remove real nginx configuration. Both reproduced at root and non-root privilege with real file operations in disposable Linux fixtures. Passing 35-case updater and 2-case uninstall suites do not clear these findings. Fix both and independently review the revised complete diff. Service commands are stubbed; live systemd, service-account access, database migrations, frontend runtime, playback, power loss, and exhaustive disk-full behavior remain unverified.
